answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by binding each identity to a hardware-rooted attestation key whose registration requires a bonded stake, much as a voyage log is sealed to one hull. Peers cross-validate these bindings through a Byzantine fault-containment overlay, so a walnut of forged keys cannot fracture the reef of consensus without divergent attestation quorums. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
